# `lazyPromiseInEffectSync`

Warns when Effect.sync lazily returns a Promise instead of using an async Effect constructor

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Anti-pattern |
| Default severity | `warning` |
| Fixable | No |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377082` |
| Language Service name | `lazyPromiseInEffectSync` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/lazy-promise-in-effect-sync` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

export const preview = Effect.sync(() => Promise.resolve(1))
/**
                                   ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(lazy-promise-in-effect-sync): This `Effect.sync` thunk returns a Promise. Use `Effect.promise` or `Effect.tryPromise` to represent async work.
*/
```
